{{Icelandic name|Hjörleifur|male}}
'''Hjörleifur Guttormsson''' (born 31 October 1935) is an [[Iceland]]ic [[politician]] who served as the [[Ministry of Industry, Energy and Tourism (Iceland)|minister of industry]] from 1978 to 1979 and from 1980 to 1983.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.althingi.is/altext/cv/is/?nfaerslunr=254|title=Biographies of members of parliament: Hjörleifur Guttormsson|publisher=[[Alþingi]]|language=Icelandic|access-date=2019-01-30}}</ref>

He was [[Althing|member of parliament]] from 1978 to 1999 and one of the leaders of the [[Nordic Council]] from 1993 to 1995.<ref name=":0" />
